title: Follow a claim back to its sources
lead: TrustLens shows what the evidence says and where it comes from. It does not label claims true or false.
evidenceCount: {count, plural, one {# piece of evidence} other {# pieces of evidence}}
demoNotice: Every claim, source and person on this site is fictional demo data.
spectrumTitle: Three ways evidence relates to a claim
principlesTitle: What TrustLens does and does not do

sideBySide.title: Evidence side by side
sideBySide.body: Each claim lists the sources that support it, the ones that contradict it and the context around it.

noVerdict.title: No verdicts
noVerdict.body: TrustLens never marks a claim true or false. It shows what the evidence says and leaves the judgment to you.

checkable.title: Sources you can check
checkable.body: Every source is assessed against stated criteria, and the reasoning stays visible.
